description: Sector and macro ROTATION map showing where the money is going. Each of ~50 sector and macro ETFs is scored on its ratio to SPY versus that ratio's 50-day and labelled GO (money already here), HOLDING (here but paused), TURNING (money arriving) or OUT (money left), with distance-to-50d %, 20-day slope % and ratio RSI. A state map, not a buy list; the payload's `reading` field notes that confirmed rotation is late for a pullback buyer. Free; data is one market day delayed.
name: get_rotation
